content.short: Montessori School is the first 'NFT serial' on TON, telling a mysterious story through unique digital collectibles.
content.description: Montessori School is a groundbreaking creative project on the TON blockchain, recognized as the network's first 'NFT serial.' The collection consists of 8,002 unique NFTs that collectively narrate a mysterious and engaging story about a school where children acquire extraordinary superpowers. Each NFT represents a character or an element of this unfolding digital lore, providing collectors with both artistic value and participation in a unique storytelling experience. Montessori School highlights the potential for NFTs to drive complex and community-driven narratives within the TON ecosystem.
content.meta: Join the mystery of Montessori School on TON. The first NFT storytelling serial, featured on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
